title: console_answer -- an agent's answer to a console question item (plan.md 7.1.1 rules 5, 6 and 9)
description: Written by the answering agent alone into its answers/ beside its console_inbox/, read by the console as display, append-only: a second answer to the same item is a new file. A question is taken up -- the agent's first stage made a goal card carrying the item's question id -- or refused, with the reason written back, never silently. Check 91 holds that every console question item has one, and that a taken-up answer names a goal card carrying that id. The librarian's answers to its three store requests are its own schema.

answer_id.description: ca-<UTC date>-<UTC time>-<four random characters>; also the answer's file name under answers/, as a store answer's is, so an answer is cited the same way in all three agents

goal_card.description: for taken_up: the goal card the first stage made, carrying question_id as its qid

reason.description: for refused: why, in words the asker can read
